## Checks

- [ ] `forge fmt --check`, `forge build --sizes` and `forge test` pass (contracts)
- [ ] Fork tests run for changes that touch live venues or governance
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and the change works on Elysium and Robinhood Chain (web)
- [ ] Docs updated in `web/content/docs` if users see a difference
- [ ] No secrets, keys or `.env` files in the diff
- [ ] No edits to the source of an already deployed contract
